title: S3 connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One S3 connector instance's settings: the bucket and prefix it lists or writes, how object notifications reach it, and how the Parquet writer rolls files. Covers both directions of the ★ S3 connector (design §33 §8 row 6; CN1 plan Task 9). `access_key_id` and `secret_access_key` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list; with iam configured they are absent.

prefix.description: The key prefix the source lists under and the sink writes under.

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for RustFS or MinIO in development and CI (CN1 Tech Stack). AWS when absent.

access_key_id.description: The static access key id. Resolved through the secret store (D189); absent when iam is used.

secret_access_key.description: The static secret access key. Resolved through the secret store (D189); absent when iam is used.

iam.description: AWS credential chain settings; the role chain is used when these are absent.

notifications.description: S3 event notifications through SQS, for the source's low-latency path (CN1 Task 9, floci in CI).

queue_url.description: The SQS queue the bucket's notifications arrive on.

poll_interval_secs.description: How often the queue is drained when notifications are absent.

decode_formats.description: Suffixes whose objects are decoded into Arrow batch events instead of being emitted as whole-object events (CN1 Task 9). An object whose suffix is not listed is one `object` event with its metadata and no data.

roll_bytes.description: The Parquet writer's file-size roll (CN1 Task 9: 128 MiB).

roll_interval_secs.description: The Parquet writer's time roll (CN1 Task 9: 5 min).

key_template.description: Sink key template, with {topic}, {partitionkey}, {subject} and {ce_id} placeholders; a lexicographic template keeps the sink's ordering per_key.
